name: Folder Classifier
info:
# Inputs
If a msg.path or a msg.folderStructure or msg.destination is sent, the msg will be used.
otherwise the node options will be used
## path
msg.path or the origin folder option assigns the directory to read the files
## destination
msg.destination or the destination folder option assigns the directory to write
## folderStructure
msg.folderStructure or his option creates an structure on the destination to move the files

## How it works
It reads the files in a folder ( not recursively )
then it check if the folders you describe on the JSON ( folderStructure) exists on the destination folder
then it creates a folder if needed

finally, which files correspond to each folder are checked by means of the extensions  and moved


# (i) This node needs FS 
(is assigned on the Funcion inside, first line, you can change it)
